title: Phase 0.1: the front door wears R7 and stops saying selling tickets and taking donations are free from day one

source.ref: §14 Phase 0.1; R7 (ADR-1735). Owner approved the headline and both money lines in chat 2026-10-13.

detail:
Measured in production 2026-10-13 (read-only): the published `home` document (14 blocks, updated 2026-09-15) has hero 'Frequency is where your local community happens' and two retired claims: the home-model Event card 'Anyone can host one, sell tickets, and take donations from day one' and the home-cta-mid body 'Hosting an Event, selling tickets, and taking donations are free from day one'. No published `pricing` document exists, so /pricing is the coded page.

Done in code: lib/page-editor/templates/home.ts carries R7 and 'plus card processing' on every 0% line; scripts/maintenance/home-copy-canon.mjs bans the claims (MONEY_CLAIMS, tested). OPEN: the guarded, reversible data migration (supabase/migrations/*_home_r7_headline_selling_starts_at_business.sql) that rewrites the published row: R7 headline + subhead, the Event card ('Anyone can host one for free. Paid tickets and donations open at Business.') and the closing band (PLAN_STORY.selling). Writing it was held for the owner's explicit go-ahead because it rewrites production front-door copy (OWN-043).
